roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and compliance within our facility.

In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive staff training programs, as well as managing our infection control initiatives. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 per hour for this full-time opportunity, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. If you are passionate about fostering a safe and knowledgeable healthcare environment, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or infection control within a healthcare setting
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to infection prevention and control
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 per hour.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a recently acquired facility, driving growth and enhancing community presence. The ideal candidate will be a results-oriented professional eager to make a significant impact.

This role requires a highly presentable individual with a proactive approach to market development and census growth. We are looking for a "hustler" who is dedicated to achieving objectives and building strong relationships. Competitive compensation is available for the right candidate who can demonstrate exceptional leadership and marketing prowess.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a healthcare or skilled nursing facility setting.
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and build strong community relationships.
Professional demeanor and excellent presentation skills.
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as needed.
Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers an excellent opportunity to provide essential therapy services on a flexible, as-needed basis, making a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

This position comes with a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, reflecting the critical nature of the role. We are also pleased to offer a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus to qualified candidates, demonstrating our commitment to attracting top talent. If you are a compassionate and skilled SLP looking for a rewarding PRN opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5K Sign on or relocation bonus

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist (PT) for a Per Diem (PRN) opportunity at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This role offers the flexibility to manage your schedule while providing essential therapy services to patients recovering from various conditions. Join a supportive team committed to patient-centered care and making a significant impact on the community.

As a PRN Physical Therapist, you will play a crucial role in assessing, planning, and implementing individualized treatment programs to help patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. This position offers competitive hourly rates and the chance to contribute to a dynamic rehabilitation environment.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Florida Physical Therapist (PT) license.
Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree from an accredited program.
Minimum of 1 year of experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred.
Demonstrated ability to provide comprehensive therapy services to a diverse patient population.
Strong communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rates for Physical Therapists are $39.00 - $40.00.
